# XCLER

> Berlin-based AI automation agency for chatbots, agents, RAG systems, and Make.com / n8n workflow automation. Also ships Next.js web, apps, and Shopify / WordPress commerce when automation needs a product surface. Primary market: Germany / DACH. Also serves Benelux and remote US (California, Florida, Chicago).

XCLER focuses ~80% on AI automation and ~20% on product surfaces. Contact: hello@xcler.dev · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923154823517

## Services

- [AI Chatbots & Agents](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/ki-chatbots-agenten): RAG assistants, LLM chatbots, AI call agents for lead qualification and support
- [Workflow Automation](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/workflow-automatisierung): Make.com, n8n, Zapier, GoHighLevel process automation
- [Web Development](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/webentwicklung): Next.js / React performance-focused sites and platforms
- [App Development](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/app-entwicklung): Custom SaaS, portals, and product apps
- [WordPress & Shopify](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/wordpress-shopify): Commerce and CMS delivery
- [WordPress Development Germany](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/wordpress-entwicklung-deutschland): Enterprise WordPress for German businesses
- [Shopify Development Germany](https://xcler.dev/leistungen/shopify-entwicklung-deutschland): Shopify builds for German commerce teams
